subject: LegacyBank on-prem air-gapped deployment - hardware & offline ops follow-up
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Diane Carter <diane.carter@legacybank.com>
Cc: infra@legacybank.com, rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com
Date: Thu, 21 Jun 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Recap + HW/Offline ops questions

Hi Diane

Thanks again for taking the call this morning. Quick recap and next steps from our side:

Call summary:
- Goal: qualify on-prem, air-gapped deployment for LegacyBank conversational assistant (customer-facing)
- Primary constraints: strict air-gap requirements, no egress, limited windowed upgrades, on-site hardware procurement
- Current ask: confirm hardware sizing, offline upgrade process, and tooling for offline package delivery/validation

Open questions we need to confirm to scope a formal proposal and site-engagement:
1) Hardware: approximate target QPS and peak concurrent sessions? Any current inference throughput targets (tokens/sec or req/min)?
2) GPUs: do you have an existing on-site GPU spec (NVIDIA A100/RTX/H100)? Do you have procurement constraints (vendor preferred, warranty/maintenance SLAs)?
3) Storage: required capacity for models+KV cache, and whether local NFS/SAN will be used or we should size for local NVMe only.
4) Upgrade cadence: how often can you accept on-site upgrade windows? Are upgrades performed by your infra team or by a vendor under escort?
5) Offline ops: what is your current process for delivering signed binaries/packages into the air-gapped environment? Is there an approved validation checklist?

Attachments: redwood_onprem_prereqs.pdf (baseline on-prem prerequisites + checklist) - attached for your infra team to review.

Next steps:
- Diane: share any existing network/DMZ diagrams and the on-site GPU/host procurement constraints
- Dev (cc'd): will share a baseline HW matrix with recommended configs and offline upgrade approach
- Marissa: propose 30-45 minute on-site qualification call next week to walk through checklist and define procurement ready spec

Proposed times (Pacific): Tue 6/27 10:00-10:45am, Wed 6/28 2:00-2:45pm. Let me know what works and I'll book a meeting.

Best,

Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com | (415) 555-0142

From: Diane Carter <diane.carter@legacybank.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: LegacyBank Infra <infra@legacybank.com>
Date: Thu, 21 Jun 2028 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Recap + HW/Offline ops questions

Hi Marissa

Thanks for the summary - appreciate the clear checklist. Answers inline:

1) Throughput: target 300 requests/minute with 95th percentile latency target of <350ms for typical customer flows (90-120 tokens per request). We'll send exact traffic profile by Monday.
2) GPUs: currently we run a small on-prem cluster with NVIDIA A100 80GB. Procurement prefers HPE/Lenovo as preferred vendors; warranty must include 4-hour onsite support (preferred).
3) Storage: working with SAN but for inference we prefer NVMe fronting (local caching). Expect model footprint ~80-120GB per model + 200GB KV/cache reserve.
4) Upgrade cadence: quarterly major upgrades ok but must be scheduled in a maintenance window; vendor personnel must be escorted.
5) Offline ops: we currently use an isolated USB transfer process with checksum validation and an internal validation checklist. We can share the checklist (redacted) - attaching latest network diagram and our validation template.

Attaching: legacybank_network_diagram_v2.pdf and legacy_offline_validation_template.docx

I can do Tue 6/27 10:00am PT for the site qualification call - that works best for the infra team.

Thanks,
Diane
Diane Carter
VP, Infrastructure | LegacyBank
Diane.Carter@legacybank.com

Attachments: legacybank_network_diagram_v2.pdf, legacy_offline_validation_template.docx

From: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>
To: Diane Carter <diane.carter@legacybank.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com
Date: Thu, 21 Jun 2028 15:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Recap + HW/Offline ops questions

Diane -

Great notes - thanks for the diagram and validation template. A few technical clarifications to help us prepare a proposal and the baseline HW matrix (attached):

- Sizing: with A100 80GB and your target (300 req/min at ~100 tokens) we recommend starting with 2x A100 nodes for redundancy, scaling to 4x for throughput headroom. If you plan model ensembles or longer contexts, consider 4+ nodes.
- Memory/Storage: 1.5TB NVMe across the cluster for model caching + 2TB local for logs/snapshots. We can support SAN-backed storage but recommend local NVMe for lowest latency.
- Network: internal east-west 25Gb recommended; ensure BMC/IPMI access is restricted and logged.

Offline upgrade approach (high level):
1) We produce a signed package and SHA256 checksum.
2) Package transferred via approved media into an ingress validation appliance (your existing process).
3) Validation appliance runs checksum and signature verification, then copies to a quarantined staging bucket.
4) On maintenance window, run a pre-check, apply package, run smoke tests, and provide a signed upgrade report back to your security team.

We can operate under your escorted vendor model; our engineers will provide documentation for the escorted upgrade and a runbook.

Attaching: baremetal_hw_matrix.xlsx (baseline configs + expected performance).

If Tue 6/27 10:00am PT works, I'll join the call and walk through the HW matrix and upgrade runbook.

-Dev
